LAREDO, Texas — Jose Manuel Estrada-Santos was arrested early Friday morning, October 23, 2026, and booked into the Webb County Jail on an alleged state jail felony charge of unauthorized use of a vehicle, according to Webb County booking records.

Estrada-Santos was arrested at 3:43 a.m. The booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956 listed him as held on an immigration hold for U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement. Bond had not been set.

A state jail felony in Texas is punishable by 180 days to two years in a state jail facility and a fine of up to $10,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Jose Manuel Estrada-Santos is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
